questions: What numerical value of KI (in a.u.) from the standard characterisation should be used in dS/dt = -Vmax*S/(Km + S + S^2/KI)?
limitations: source.txt requires KI but supplies no numerical value; the referenced standard characterisation is not provided. The weak exercise of substrate inhibition does not determine KI or justify omitting S^2/KI.
The unit of KI is inferred by dimensional consistency: S^2/KI must have the same concentration unit as Km and S.
No trajectory can be determined at the 41 requested sampling times without KI. The simulation was not run.
